tasks.label: 重启 TypeScript 服务器
tasks.command: echo '请在 VS Code 中按 F1 或 Ctrl+Shift+P，输入: TypeScript: Restart TS Server'

tasks.label: vitest-check
tasks.command: npx vitest run 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'Test Files|Tests ' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }

tasks.label: vitest-summary
tasks.command: npx vitest run 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'Test Files|Tests |Duration ' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }

tasks.label: vitest-registry-test
tasks.command: npx vitest run tests/design-session-registry.test.ts --reporter verbose 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 80

tasks.label: vitest-registry-grep
tasks.command: npx vitest run tests/design-session-registry.test.ts --reporter verbose 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern '✓|×|FAIL|Test Files|Tests ' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line }

tasks.label: vitest-reg-summary
tasks.command: npx vitest run tests/design-session-registry.test.ts --reporter verbose 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern 'FAIL|Test Files|Tests ' -SimpleMatch
